text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how hard training gets, Hishi Akebono's smile never falters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to do everything I can to support her, so I cut back on sleep to maximize my work hours. Then, on one of my days off…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! I had a feeling you'd be here, even though it's our day off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Why don't you take a break so we can have teatime? ☆
choice_data_list: Thanks, but I still have work to—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All aboard the Teatime Train!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aaand hup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Stay still or you might get hurt! Okay, here we gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without warning, Hishi Akebono throws me over her shoulder and carries me off to the…
choice_data_list: What are we doing at the cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I asked if we could borrow the school kitchen a little, to make some food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Some of the desserts are already done, so I'll go get them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much for waiting! ☆ Your first course is doughnuts and ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She places a plate on the table and I see the cutesy little doughnuts half-dipped in chocolate next to some scoops of gorgeous emerald ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The food looks incredible, but my attention is elsewhere.
choice_data_list: Is that your signature racewear you're wearing?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It is! Isn't it great? They made it just the way I asked!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, you'd better hurry and eat up before the ice cream melts. There are still plenty more dishes to come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She brings out dessert after dessert. I eat every one, letting their sweetness spread throughout my body, but it's not until I'm almost full that I realize something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Trainer?
choice_data_list: The desserts you've been serving me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You finally noticed? Ehehe! That's right! Everything I served you is somewhere on my signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true. Doughnuts, ice cream, and strawberry shortcake have all been worked into the design of her outfit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Um… Trainer? Did you think the doughnuts and cake were buono?
choice_data_list: Of course! They were very buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What a relief! Buono things bring so much happiness!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whenever I'm full and happy… I just can't help smiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought it'd be nice if I could cheer everyone up a little just by showing them my signature racewear! Y'know, before and after I race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It'd mean a lot to me if I got to see the crowds smiling with their whole heart, just like you are now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she mentions it, my expression's probably been stern lately, what with how busy I've been.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for the wonderful meal!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome! But there are still some cookies left, so I'll go bake them now! ☆
choice_data_list: Do they look like the ones on your shoes and back?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: They do! I made some in different shapes too, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I wonder which shape you'll like the most…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wait right here! I'll bring you aaall the buono so you can smile from ear to ear! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cookies are warm and subtly sweet, and they almost taste like Hishi Akebono's hopes made into dessert form.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, you don't have to! I know you're exhausted, so you can sit back and rela—
choice_data_list: I want to make more buono things with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Make more buono? …With me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay… Yeah, sure! It won't be the same if we don't make them together! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's create lots of lots of buono things, Trainer! The more buono, the more smiles there'll be! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The cookies we bake are a mix of different shapes and tastes, and they turn out to be the funnest, most buono cookies I've ever made!
